items.title_en: AI;DR (AI; Didn't Read)
items.title_zh: AI；DR（AI 未读）
items.summary_en: A candid take on how AI claims often outpace evidence, urging readers to actually verify sources and not accept marketing hype. It highlights practical heuristics for evaluating AI products and research, including checking data usage and real-world benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: 对人工智能言论中常见的证据不足现象给出直白观点，敦促读者亲自核验来源，而非盲信市场宣传。提出评估 AI 产品与研究的实用准则，如数据使用、真实世界基准等。

items.title_en: How Bluesky draws its logo on screenshots
items.title_zh: Bluesky 在截图上绘制徽标的机制
items.summary_en: The post reveals how Bluesky overlays its logo on screenshots, including the rendering and placement choices that aim to brand visuals without obscuring content. It highlights potential performance and privacy considerations tied to on-screen watermarking.
items.summary_zh: 文章揭示 Bluesky 在截图上水印的渲染与放置策略，力求在不遮挡内容的前提下实现品牌曝光，并讨论与性能和隐私相关的潜在影响。

items.title_en: GPT-5.6 Sol Pricing Cut by 50%
items.title_zh: GPT-5.6 Sol 定价降幅50%
items.summary_en: OpenRouter cuts GPT-5.6 Sol pricing by half, lowering entry costs for developers and small teams to experiment with the service. The move underscores ongoing AI price competition and could accelerate broader experimentation with AI tooling.
items.summary_zh: OpenRouter 将 GPT-5.6 Sol 的定价降至一半，降低开发者与小团队试用成本，凸显 AI 服务领域的价格竞争，并可能推动更广泛的 AI 工具试用。

items.title_en: Israel creates fake think tank in likely attempt to dupe AI chatbots
items.title_zh: 以色列设立假冒智库以误导 AI 聊天机器人
items.summary_en: An investigative piece reports efforts to influence AI chatbots by feeding them tainted or crafted content via a fake think tank, highlighting the risks of sourcing and prompt manipulation in large language models.
items.summary_zh: 报道指出通过伪造智库向 AI 聊天机器人注入定制内容来影响其回答，凸显大语言模型在数据来源与提示词操控方面的风险。

items.title_en: Quake Shareware, a CD-ROM just a little too full
items.title_zh: Quake 共享版：光碟容量略显紧张导致的取舍
items.summary_en: The piece explains how the Quake shareware release was constrained by CD-ROM capacity, forcing content trims and distribution choices. It sheds light on how physical media limits shaped early PC gaming experiences and accessibility.
items.summary_zh: 文章解释了《Quake》共享版在光碟容量限制下所做的取舍与分发决策，揭示了物理介质限制如何影响早期 PC 游戏的体验与普及。

items.title_en: A Preview of DuckDB v2.0
items.title_zh: DuckDB v2.0 预览
items.summary_en: DuckDB releases a preview of version 2.0, signaling a refreshed optimizer, better parallelism, and richer analytics features for in-process data workloads. The update aims to accelerate local data science workflows and improve enterprise-style SQL capabilities inside embeddable analytics engines.
items.summary_zh: DuckDB 发布 v2.0 预览，重点在提升查询优化、并行性能，以及为嵌入式分析增加的新特性。此举有望加速本地数据科学工作流，并提升对 SQL 的支持与可用性。

items.title_en: Ask HN: Alternatives to GitHub
items.title_zh: Ask HN：GitHub 的替代方案
items.summary_en: Survey of alternatives like GitLab, Gitea, Sourcehut, and self-hosted options, weighing trade-offs around privacy, control, and CI/CD integration. Practical guidance helps teams consider independence from GitHub without sacrificing collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 对 GitLab、Gitea、Sourcehut 等替代方案以及自托管选项进行盘点，分析隐私、控制权与持续集成/部署集成之间的权衡。为团队在不依赖 GitHub 的前提下维持协作提供实用指引。

items.title_en: Qwen3.8 27B scores 52 on Artificial Analysis
items.title_zh: Qwen3.8 27B 在 Artificial Analysis 基准测试中得分52
items.summary_en: Qwen3.8 with 27B parameters scored 52 on the Artificial Analysis benchmark, marking competitive performance for a mid-sized model. The result helps map where 27B models stand on reasoning tasks and guides developers choosing models for cost-effective deployments.
items.summary_zh: Qwen3.8 27B 在人工分析基准上得分 52，显示中等规模模型在推理等任务上的竞争力。该分数有助于了解 27B 模型在成本效益与能力之间的取舍，帮助开发者选型。

items.title_en: Incident with Github.com
items.title_zh: GitHub.com 服务中断事件
items.summary_en: A GitHub.com incident disrupted access for a portion of users, prompting status pages and incident reports. The outage underscores the fragility of central code-hosting platforms and reinforces the value of diversified tooling and robust incident response.
items.summary_zh: GitHub.com 遭遇服务中断，部分用户无法访问相关服务，相关页面与公告随之发布。此事凸显集中式代码托管平台的脆弱性，也强调在多工具和强健事故响应方面的必要性。

items.title_en: The Benchmarkpocalypse
items.title_zh: 基准灾难
items.summary_en: The Benchmarkpocalypse argues that the current flood of benchmarks across hardware and AI has produced a noisy, unreliable landscape, with cherry-picked results and non-reproducible setups becoming common. It highlights how decision-makers can be misled by vanity numbers and calls for stricter standards, standardized workloads, and transparent methodologies.
items.summary_zh: 基准测评的激增导致结果噪声大、难以重复，常见的是挑选性数据与不可复现的测试。对决策者而言，这些 vanity numbers 可能误导判断，文章呼吁建立更严格的基准标准、统一工作负载与透明的方法论。

items.title_en: Fairphone 6 and PostmarketOS working main camera
items.title_zh: Fairphone 6 在 PostmarketOS 上实现主摄像头工作
items.summary_en: PostmarketOS progress now enables the Fairphone 6’s main camera, marking a notable milestone for open-source mobile OS support on modern hardware. Ongoing work will likely improve stability and feature parity with mainstream OS ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: PostmarketOS 已实现 Fairphone 6 的主摄像头，这标志着开源移动操作系统在现代硬件上的重要里程碑。后续工作预计会提升稳定性与功能对齐 mainstream 生态。

items.title_en: Universal Health Coverage Could Save $1T and 114k Lives a Year, Yale Study
items.title_zh: 耶鲁研究：全民医疗覆盖每年可拯救1万亿美元和11.4万条生命
items.summary_en: Yale researchers estimate universal health coverage could save about $1 trillion and 114,000 lives annually by reducing inefficiencies and expanding access. The study adds to the policy debate on financing and outcomes of universal healthcare.
items.summary_zh: 耶鲁研究估算全民医疗覆盖每年可通过降低低效与扩大覆盖，节省约1万亿美元并挽救11.4万条生命，为全民医保的财政和成效辩论提供新证据。

items.title_en: AI-Generated GitHub Copilot “Autofix” Allowed Compromise of Snowflake's Jira
items.title_zh: Copilot 自动修复导致 Snowflake Jira 安全风险
items.summary_en: An incident shows AI-generated Autofix suggestions from Copilot could be accepted in Snowflake's Jira, potentially bypassing ticket safeguards. The episode exposes how AI-driven code edits can inadvertently undermine access controls in critical developer tooling. It underscores the need for guardrails in AI-assisted CI/CD and issue-tracking workflows.
items.summary_zh: AI 生成的 Autofix 建议可能被 Snowflake 的 Jira 接受，进而绕过工单的保护机制，暴露潜在风险。此事揭示了 AI 驱动的代码修复可能无意中削弱关键开发工具的访问控制。强调在 AI 辅助的 CI/CD 和工单工作流中需要设置安全边界。

items.title_en: Incident with Github.com
items.title_zh: GitHub 事件：核心服务中断
items.summary_en: GitHub reported an incident affecting core services, causing degraded performance and outages for repositories, issues, and CI workflows. Engineers worked to identify the root cause and restore services, underscoring how outages ripple through developer tooling and the importance of resilient incident response.
items.summary_zh: GitHub 报告了一起影响核心服务的事故，导致代码仓库、问题跟踪和持续集成工作流等功能的性能下降甚至中断。工程师正在定位根因并恢复服务，这次事件凸显了开发工具的脆弱性以及建立韧性响应的重要性。

items.title_en: GPU Offload in Rust: Portable, Safe, and Fast
items.title_zh: Rust 的 GPU 卸载：便携、安全、快速
items.summary_en: A Rust-based approach to offloading GPU computation emphasizes portability, memory safety, and speed. By leveraging Rust's zero-cost abstractions and safe interfaces, developers can port GPU work across backends with fewer bugs and better maintenance; the work could impact HPC, ML inference, and game dev.
items.summary_zh: 基于 Rust 的 GPU 卸载方法强调便携性、内存安全与速度。借助 Rust 的零成本抽象和安全接口，开发者可以在不同后端之间端到端迁移 GPU 任务，提升稳定性与可维护性，对高性能计算、机器学习推理和游戏开发等领域意义重大。

items.title_en: How to disable or avoid intrusive AI
items.title_zh: 如何禁用或避免侵入式 AI
items.summary_en: Practical guidance for reducing AI intrusiveness, including privacy-preserving settings, opt-out controls, and selecting lighter-weight alternatives. The piece emphasizes proactive user agency as AI integration expands.
items.summary_zh: 提供避免侵入式 AI 的实用方法，包括隐私保护设置、退出控制和选择更轻量替代方案。文章强调在 AI 日益普及的场景中，主动掌控权的重要性。

items.title_en: Repair Cafe – Fix Your Broken Items
items.title_zh: 修理咖啡馆：修复你的破损物件
items.summary_en: Repair Café events bring volunteers and neighbors together to fix broken items, reducing waste and teaching practical repair skills. The movement scales community resilience and sustainable consumption by turning fix-it culture into social action.
items.summary_zh: 修理咖啡馆让志愿者和邻里聚在一起修理损坏物品，减少浪费并传授实用的修理技能。此运动通过将修理文化转化为社会行动，提升社区韧性与可持续消费。

items.title_en: Google wins bankruptcy auction for Spirit Airlines emails, chats, documents
items.title_zh: Google 在 Spirit Airlines 破产拍卖中赢得数据资产
items.summary_en: Google wins a bankruptcy auction to acquire Spirit Airlines' emails, chats, and documents, illustrating how data assets surface in insolvency and can fuel analytics, compliance, or competitive intelligence.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌在 Spirit Airlines 的破产拍卖中获得邮件、聊天记录与文档等数据资产，展示破产程序中数据的潜在价值及对分析、合规与情报的影响。

items.title_en: Qwen 3.8 27B is excellent, but it defaults to overthinking things
items.title_zh: Qwen 3.8 27B：出色但默认易过度推理
items.summary_en: Qwen 3.8 27B performs strongly, but its default prompting overemphasizes exhaustive reasoning, slowing or muddying responses. The author discusses practical tweaks to get clearer, faster outputs without sacrificing accuracy.
items.summary_zh: Qwen 3.8 27B 性能出色，但默认设置容易走向冗长推理，影响输出的清晰度与速度。文中给出在不牺牲准确性的前提下提高回答简洁性的实用调整。

items.title_en: GPT 5.6 Sol is the best "vision" model OpenAI ever released
items.title_zh: GPT-5.6 Sol：OpenAI 有史以来最强的视觉模型
items.summary_en: GPT-5.6 Sol is argued to deliver standout vision capabilities, outperforming prior OpenAI vision models on recognition and multimodal tasks. The integration of vision-based reasoning could push developers toward end-to-end AI apps, though questions remain about reliability and safety in real-world use.
items.summary_zh: 据称 GPT-5.6 Sol 在视觉能力上表现突出，超越了之前的 OpenAI 视觉模型，在识别与多模态任务上更有作为。将视觉推理整合到核心能力中，可能促使开发者构建端到端的 AI 应用，但现实场景中的可靠性与安全性仍存挑战。

items.title_en: Sun Clock
items.title_zh: Sun Clock
items.summary_en: Sun Clock is a project about solar time data and daylight tracking.
items.summary_zh: Sun Clock 是一个关于太阳时与日照数据跟踪的项目。

items.title_en: Anthropic's ‘watermark’ text adulteration in Claude is a perversion of writing
items.title_zh: Anthropic 的 Claude 水印文本篡改是对写作的亵渎
items.summary_en: The piece condemns Claude’s watermark-based text adulteration as undermining writing quality and integrity, arguing that watermarking AI-produced text distorts authorship and trust. It situates watermarking within broader debates about authenticity, control, and the consequences of AI-generated content in professional writing.
items.summary_zh: 文章批评 Claude 的水印文本篡改扭曲写作质量与诚信，认为对 AI 产出文本打水印会损害署名与信任。讨论将水印纳入关于真实性、控制权及 AI 内容在专业写作中的影响的广泛议题。

items.title_en: An update on leaving Gmail for Fastmail
items.title_zh: 离开 Gmail，转用 Fastmail 的最新进展
items.summary_en: The author reports on migrating from Gmail to Fastmail, weighing privacy, UX, and performance trade-offs. The update offers practical tips for email migration, plus reflections on where modern email services stand in terms of control and reliability.
items.summary_zh: 作者分享从 Gmail 迁移到 Fastmail 的体验，比较隐私、用户体验和性能的取舍。提供迁移的实用建议，并讨论当下邮箱服务在可控性与可靠性方面的现状。

items.title_en: India has paved the way for charging merchants a fee on UPI transactions
items.title_zh: 印度为向UPI交易向商家收费铺路
items.summary_en: India's policy signals that merchants can be charged fees on UPI payments, potentially shifting the economics of digital transactions. Expect impact on merchant acceptance dynamics, competitive pricing, and user experience as payment rails evolve.
items.summary_zh: 印度放开对 UPI 交易向商户收费的路径，将改变数字支付的成本结构。对商户接受度、定价竞争和用户体验等方面都会产生影响，支付体系也因此在演化。

items.title_en: Apple's App Tracking Transparency treated its own apps better than rivals
items.title_zh: 苹果的应用追踪透明度对自家应用比对手更友好
items.summary_en: Germany's antitrust regulator finds Apple's ATT framework treated its own apps more favorably than competitors, raising concerns about fair competition in app tracking and data practices.
items.summary_zh: 德国反垄断机构发现苹果的应用追踪透明度在对待自家应用时更有利，质疑在应用跟踪和数据实践方面的公平竞争。

items.title_en: Los Puesteros, solitary men who look after ranches and livestock in Patagonia
items.title_zh: 巴塔哥尼亚的孤独守牧人：照料牧场与牲畜的他们
items.summary_en: Portraits and stories of Patagonia's solitary ranch workers, detailing the daily routines, isolation, and landscapes they inhabit. It’s a meditation on human scale against vast geography and a window into rural life.
items.summary_zh: 巴塔哥尼亚地区看护牧场与牲畜的孤独守望者的肖像，揭示他们的日常、孤独与广阔景致。此文兼具对人和环境的思考，为偏远地区的乡村生活提供观照。

items.title_en: Judge sets framework for Nine PBS to retrieve archival data
items.title_zh: 法官为 Nine PBS 提取档案数据设定框架
items.summary_en: A court outlines the framework for Nine PBS to retrieve archival materials, clarifying rights, access, and preservation responsibilities. The decision could influence how public broadcasters negotiate data access and digitization of archives.
items.summary_zh: 法庭为 Nine PBS 提取档案材料设定了执行框架，明确了数据访问、版权与保存责任。该判决可能影响公共广播机构在档案获取与数字化方面的协作方式。

items.title_en: Claude: System Prompts
items.title_zh: Claude：系统提示
items.summary_en: Claude introduces new capabilities around system prompts, enabling more reliable persona control and safety constraints across conversations. The update emphasizes persistent or configurable prompts to steer model behavior without altering user prompts. This matters for developers building chatbots who require predictable, policy-compliant outputs.
items.summary_zh: Claude 引入了系统提示的新能力，使对话中的角色与行为更加可控和安全。更新强调可配置的系统提示，以在不改动用户提示的前提下引导模型行为。对于需要可预测、合规输出的聊天机器人开发者尤为重要。

items.title_en: Tell HN: Cloudflare silently injects its analytics when you switch nameservers
items.title_zh: Tell HN: Cloudflare 在切换域名服务器时悄然注入分析代码
items.summary_en: A post alleges Cloudflare injects its analytics code when you switch DNS, enabling traffic telemetry without explicit consent. The finding raises questions about privacy, transparency, and the trade-offs of using a privacy-focused CDN.
items.summary_zh: 有人指称 Cloudflare 在你切换 DNS 时悄然注入分析代码，进行流量遥测而未征得明确同意。这一发现引发对隐私、透明度及使用隐私导向 CDNs 时权衡取舍的讨论。

items.title_en: A third world engineer responds to “RISC-V: They should have known better”
items.title_zh: 来自第三世界的工程师回应“RISC-V：他们本应更懂行”的质疑
items.summary_en: A software/embedded engineer from a developing country pushes back against a dismissive claim that RISC-V developers should have known better, arguing that open ISAs democratize hardware innovation and reduce dependence on entrenched vendors.
items.summary_zh: 一位来自发展中国家的工程师反驳对 RISC-V 开发者应更知情的轻视论调，认为开放指令集民主化硬件创新，降低对传统厂商的依赖。文中强调资金、供应链与教育等现实约束其实可能催生符合本地条件的务实进展。

items.title_en: Buy Your Friends Batteries
items.title_zh: 买给朋友的电池
items.summary_en: Gifting batteries can be a practical, tech-friendly present in a device-saturated world.
items.summary_zh: 在设备充斥的世界中，给朋友送电池也是一种实用且贴心的礼物。

items.title_en: Firefox for iOS now has a native adblocker
items.title_zh: iOS 版 Firefox 现已内置原生广告拦截器
items.summary_en: Firefox iOS now ships with a native ad-blocker, improving privacy and page speed by blocking trackers and ads at the browser level. This reduces data usage and helps users bypass some invasive tracking without relying on external extensions.
items.summary_zh: iOS 版 Firefox 增添原生广告拦截功能，通过浏览器层面屏蔽跟踪与广告来提升隐私和页面加载速度。减少数据使用，并在无需外部扩展的情况下改善用户体验。

items.title_en: Anthropic's War on open source AI
items.title_zh: Anthropic 与开源 AI 的战斗
items.summary_en: Discussion of Anthropic's stance toward open-source AI and tensions with the open-source ecosystem, questioning how safety-focused approaches intersect with openness and community contributions.
items.summary_zh: 讨论 Anthropic 对开源 AI 的立场及其与开源生态的紧张关系，质问在安全优先的取向下开放性与社区贡献之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Linear algebra done right
items.title_zh: 线性代数的正确做法——Axler 著
items.summary_en: Axler argues for a streamlined, proof-oriented treatment of linear algebra that starts with vector spaces and linear maps, not determinants. The book emphasizes intuition and structure over computational recipes, helping readers grasp spectral theory earlier and more cleanly.
items.summary_zh: Axler 主张以向量空间与线性变换为出发点的线性代数教学，摒弃以行列式为中心的传统做法，强调直觉与结构，较早引入特征值与谱理论，帮助读者建立清晰的理论框架。

items.title_en: Will you have spent more of your life with computers than your family?
items.title_zh: 你会不会把一生中更多的时光花在电脑上，而不是陪伴家人？
items.summary_en: A reflection on time spent with technology vs with loved ones, prompting readers to consider digital balance and long-term well-being. It may explore personal habits and broader societal trends around screen time.
items.summary_zh: 关于花在电脑上的时间是否将超过陪伴家人的反思，促使读者考虑数字生活的平衡与长期幸福。文章探讨个人习惯和屏幕时间的社会趋势。

items.title_en: Stripe will reportedly acquire OpenRouter for $7B+
items.title_zh: Stripe 将以约 70 亿美元收购 OpenRouter
items.summary_en: Stripe reportedly plans to acquire OpenRouter, an AI gateway startup, in a deal valued around $7B+. The move signals Stripe's push into developer-facing AI tooling and model routing, potentially accelerating integration of AI into payments and commerce.
items.summary_zh: 据报道 Stripe 将收购 AI 网关 OpenRouter，交易额约 70 亿美元。这笔交易凸显 Stripe 在面向开发者的 AI 工具与模型路由领域的布局，或将加速将 AI 融入支付与电商场景。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Speko (YC S26) – OpenRouter for Voice AI
items.title_zh: Speko（YC S26）– 面向语音 AI 的开源路由器
items.summary_en: Speko offers an open router platform that routes voice AI workloads, enabling developers to host models locally and optimize latency. By abstracting model hosting and data flow, it aims to simplify building privacy-friendly voice assistants and AI apps.
items.summary_zh: Speko 提供一个用于语音 AI 的开源路由平台，便于开发者在本地托管模型并优化延迟。该方案通过抽象化模型托管与数据流，旨在简化隐私友好的语音助手和 AI 应用的搭建。

items.title_en: How to put 170 atoms in an atom
items.title_zh: 如何在一个原子中放入170个原子
items.summary_en: Explores a playful thought experiment about packing 170 atoms into what we call an atom, highlighting atomic-scale limits.
items.summary_zh: 通过一个关于在一个原子中放入170个原子的玩笑设想，揭示原子尺度的极限。

items.title_en: How do functions like alloca allocate memory from the stack?
items.title_zh: alloca 等从栈分配内存的原理
items.summary_en: The post explains how alloca-like functions allocate memory from the stack, including lifetime semantics and interactions with stack growth. It also warns about portability and potential stack overflow risks.
items.summary_zh: 文章讲解了诸如 alloca 的函数如何从栈中分配内存，涉及生命周期语义与栈增长的交互，并提示可移植性与栈溢出的风险。

items.title_en: GitHub degradation affects Cursor Origin, its new Git platform
items.title_zh: GitHub 故障波及 Cursor Origin 新平台
items.summary_en: A GitHub degradation affects Cursor Origin, a newly launched Git hosting platform, underscoring the fragility of relying on a single ecosystem and the value of offline and alternative tooling.
items.summary_zh: GitHub 的降级影响到新推出的 Cursor Origin Git 托管平台，凸显对单一生态依赖的脆弱性以及离线与替代工具的重要性。

items.title_en: GIMP Development Update
items.title_zh: GIMP 开发更新
items.summary_en: GIMP announces August 2026 development updates, detailing new features, bug fixes, and upcoming milestones. The update signals continued evolution of the open-source image editor with focus on performance and usability.
items.summary_zh: GIMP 发布 2026 年 8 月的开发更新，列出新功能、错误修复与未来里程碑。该更新显示开源图像编辑器在性能与易用性方面的持续改进。

items.title_en: My friends all hate AI; I just joined an AI startup
items.title_zh: 我的朋友都讨厌人工智能；我刚加入一家 AI 初创公司
items.summary_en: The author explains why, despite friends’ skepticism, joining an AI startup offers real-world AI work, mission-driven projects, and a chance to shape the trajectory of AI-powered products.
items.summary_zh: 作者解释为何在朋友质疑之际仍加入一家 AI 初创公司，强调现实世界的 AI 工作、使命驱动的项目，以及对 AI 产品发展轨迹的影响力。

items.title_en: On AI regulation and messaging
items.title_zh: 关于 AI 监管与信息传达
items.summary_en: Argues for thoughtfully calibrated AI regulation and clearer messaging to align policymakers, developers, and the public, noting the risk of regulation lag and hype. The piece emphasizes actionable, measurable rules that support innovation while mitigating risk.
items.summary_zh: 主张在 AI 监管上保持审慎与可衡量的政策信号，并加强对外信息传达的一致性，以帮助决策者、开发者与公众同步理解，避免监管滞后与炒作。

items.title_en: Mexico crackdown on coastal development
items.title_zh: 墨西哥加强海岸开发整治力度
items.summary_en: Authorities are tightening oversight on coastal development to protect ecosystems and communities, affecting developers and tourism. The crackdown reflects growing emphasis on climate resilience and sustainable planning in coastal zones.
items.summary_zh: 政府加强对沿海开发的监管，以保护生态与社区，这将影响开发商与旅游业。此轮整治体现了对沿海地区气候韧性与可持续规划的日益重视。

items.title_en: Models Are Getting Dumber on Purpose
items.title_zh: 模型在有意降级以提升安全性
items.summary_en: The post argues that AI models are getting intentionally dumber to improve safety, control, or cost, rather than simply getting smarter from more data. It discusses the tension between capability and governance, and what that means for developers relying on ever more powerful systems.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，AI 模型正被有意降级，以提高安全性、可控性以及成本效益，而不仅仅是靠更多数据来提升能力。讨论了能力与治理之间的张力，以及开发者在日益强大的系统面前所面临的取舍。

items.title_en: Show HN: Desktopcolors.com – A museum for solid background colors of classic OS
items.title_zh: Show HN：Desktopcolors.com——经典操作系统背景色博物馆
items.summary_en: Desktopcolors.com curates solid background colors used by classic operating systems, serving designers with nostalgic palettes and a case study in data collection. It also sparks reflection on UI color history and accessibility choices.
items.summary_zh: Desktopcolors.com 汇总了经典操作系统所使用的统一背景色，为设计师提供怀旧调色板，同时展示数据收集与组织的实践。它也引发对界面颜色历史和无障碍设计的思考。

items.title_en: Research papers using "kidney disappointment" instead of "kidney failure"
items.title_zh: 研究论文把“kidney disappointment”代替“kidney failure”？
items.summary_en: A linguistic note highlights papers using 'kidney disappointment' instead of 'kidney failure', illustrating how terminology can soften or reframing research narratives.
items.summary_zh: 有论文把“kidney disappointment”用于替代“kidney failure”，以缓和叙事语气。该现象反映了语言选择如何影响患者感知与科学传播的方式。

items.title_en: Reticulum – Decentralized Mesh Network
items.title_zh: Reticulum 去中心化网状网络
items.summary_en: Reticulum is a decentralized mesh network project aiming to provide resilient, censorship-resistant communications without relying on centralized infrastructure. It emphasizes privacy-preserving routing and offline-first capability, enabling devices to talk directly in ad-hoc networks.
items.summary_zh: Reticulum 是一个去中心化的网状网络项目，致力于在不依赖集中基础设施的情况下提供稳健、抗审查的通信。它强调隐私友好的路由和离线优先能力，使设备能够在临时网络中直接互联。

items.title_en: Online clinics and influencers are promoting Cialis as a longevity drug
items.title_zh: 网诊诊所与网红推销 Cialis 作为长寿药
items.summary_en: NPR reports online clinics and influencers are promoting Cialis as a longevity drug, raising concerns about health misinformation and safety.
items.summary_zh: 国家公共广播机构报道在线诊所和网红将 Cialis 作为长寿药进行宣传，引发对健康信息误导与安全性的担忧。

items.title_en: The federal keyword lists that canceled billions in research funding
items.title_zh: 取消数十亿美元研究资助的联邦关键词清单
items.summary_en: A scrutiny of federal keyword lists that flagged proposals for funding, revealing how automated filters or search terms led to billions of dollars in research funding being canceled.
items.summary_zh: 报道指出联邦关键词清单在资助评审中起到关键作用，导致数十亿美元研究经费被取消。文章分析自动化筛选与用词偏见对研究方向的影响，以及政策层面的改进需求。

items.title_en: GitHub down again? no PR access
items.title_zh: GitHub 再度宕机？无法进行 PR
items.summary_en: Outage reports suggest GitHub is experiencing issues preventing pull requests from being opened or merged. The disruption highlights how critical PR tooling is to collaboration and how teams adapt when primary code-review channels go dark.
items.summary_zh: 关于 GitHub 的中断报道显示，相关服务无法创建或合并拉取请求。此类故障凸显了 PR 工具在团队协作中的核心作用，以及在主工作流受限时的应对之道。

items.title_en: Roboflow Playground: Try and Compare 30 Computer Vision Models
items.title_zh: Roboflow Playground：试用并比较30个计算机视觉模型
items.summary_en: Roboflow Playground lets you experiment with and benchmark 30 computer vision models side-by-side, lowering the barrier to model comparison. It helps practitioners understand trade-offs in accuracy, speed, and resource use across CV architectures.
items.summary_zh: Roboflow Playground 让你并排试用并对比 30 个计算机视觉模型，降低模型比较的门槛。帮助开发者权衡不同架构在精度、推理速度和资源消耗上的差异。

items.title_en: The AI Credit Resale Economy
items.title_zh: AI 计算信用再销售经济
items.summary_en: An emerging market is forming around trading AI compute credits and usage rights, with token brokers providing liquidity and signaling prices. The system could lower the barrier to AI access for startups and individuals, but it also invites resale scams and regulatory scrutiny as standards and protections emerge.
items.summary_zh: 一个围绕AI计算信用和使用权买卖的新兴市场正在形成，经纪人聚合流动性并传递价格信号。该模式可能降低创业公司和个人获得AI能力的门槛，但随着标准化和保护机制尚未完善，也引发转卖欺诈与监管关注。

items.title_en: The Life and Death of Direct File [pdf]
items.title_zh: Direct File 的兴衰
items.summary_en: A historical examination of the Direct File approach, tracing its rise, adoption, and eventual decline. The piece draws lessons for contemporary data storage and retrieval architectures.
items.summary_zh: 对 Direct File 方法的历史进行回顾，梳理其兴起、应用与最终式微的原因。 从中提炼对当代数据存储与检索架构的启示。

items.title_en: Nvidia dramatically reduces amount of OpenAI infra financing it may guarantee
items.title_zh: 英伟达大幅削减对 OpenAI 基础设施融资担保金额
items.summary_en: NVIDIA is scaling back the amount of OpenAI infrastructure financing it may guarantee, trimming the potential-backed spend on data-center deployments. The move reflects risk management as AI workloads scale and could influence OpenAI’s ability to rapidly scale its compute needs. It signals a shift in how AI ecosystem players back AI workloads.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达大幅削减对 OpenAI 基础设施融资担保的金额，减少对数据中心部署的潜在背书支出。这一举措反映了在 AI 工作负载规模化过程中的风险管理，也可能影响 OpenAI 快速扩展算力的能力，显示出 AI 生态参与者背书 AI 工作负载的策略正在发生变化。

items.title_en: Self hosted email continues to steeply decline
items.title_zh: 自托管邮件的采用率继续大幅下降
items.summary_en: Self-hosted email adoption is declining as users migrate to cloud providers, due to security, maintenance, and reliability concerns; the trend has implications for privacy, independence, and resilience of communications.
items.summary_zh: 自托管邮件的采用率持续下降，用户转向云端服务，原因包括安全、维护与可靠性方面的考虑。这一趋势影响到隐私、自治以及通信韧性的长期走向。

items.title_en: How to ship a database every day
items.title_zh: 如何每天发布数据库
items.summary_en: An outline of building a robust data plane that can deploy database changes daily, covering automation, schema versioning, and rollback strategies. The piece emphasizes industrialized data release engineering for modern apps.
items.summary_zh: 概述构建可每日发布数据库变更的鲁棒数据管道，涵盖自动化、模式版本控制与回滚策略，强调面向现代应用的持续数据发布工程。

items.title_en: Show HN: Sokoban AI Solver
items.title_zh: Show HN：Sokoban AI 求解器
items.summary_en: A Sokoban AI solver project demonstrates how AI planning and search can crack classic puzzles, often using heuristics to prune the state space. It serves as a practical visualization of AI techniques in action and a useful teaching tool for algorithm design.
items.summary_zh: 该 Show HN 项目展示了如何用 AI 规划和搜索解决 Sokoban 这类经典难题，通常结合启发式规则来裁剪状态空间。它直观地展示了 AI 技术在实际问题中的应用，也是学习算法设计的有用资源。

items.title_en: We Are Forking dotenvy into dotenv-ng
items.title_zh: 我们将dotenvy Fork 成dotenv-ng
items.summary_en: dotenvy, a library for loading environment variables, is being forked into dotenv-ng to improve maintenance, API design, and compatibility with evolving Rust ecosystems. The move aims to streamline contributions and future-proof the project.
items.summary_zh: 团队宣布将 dotenvy 项目 Fork 出一个新库 dotenv-ng，以改善维护、API 设计以及与未来 Rust 生态的兼容性。此举旨在简化贡献流程并对项目进行前瞻性改造。

items.title_en: Memory prices climb 500% in 12 months, up to 10x the lowest ever tracked prices
items.title_zh: 内存价格在一年内上涨 500%
items.summary_en: Memory prices surged 500% year over year, with high-end DDR5 kits reaching thousands of dollars per kit; supply-chain pressures and demand for AI workloads drive the spike. The article warns about the impact on builders and data centers, and signals potential normalization after inventory adjustments.
items.summary_zh: 内存价格在一年内暴涨约 500%，高端 DDR5 套件价格甚至达到数千美元。供应链压力和对 AI 工作负载的需求推动价格上涨，文章分析对硬件建设者与数据中心的影响，并暗示库存回稳后可能回落。

items.title_en: Stripe to Buy OpenRouter for $7B
items.title_zh: Stripe 将以超过70亿美元收购 OpenRouter
items.summary_en: Stripe is nearing a deal to acquire OpenRouter, boosting its AI infra stack and platform capabilities. The move signals fintech’s push into AI tooling, potentially simplifying access to model serving, routing, and developer tooling for Stripe’s ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: Stripe 接近以超过70亿美元收购 OpenRouter，进一步扩展其 AI 基础设施和平台能力。这一举动显示金融科技领域对 AI 工具的整合需求，可能简化模型服务、路由和开发工具在 Stripe 生态中的接入。

items.title_en: The only known trebuchet casualty in history
items.title_zh: 历史上唯一已知的投石机伤亡事件
items.summary_en: Ars Technica recounts the sole documented trebuchet casualty in history, offering a quirky peek into medieval siege warfare and the human cost of engineering wonders.
items.summary_zh: Ars Technica 报道历史上唯一一例投石机伤亡事件，提供对中世纪围城战与工程奇观的人性代价的有趣观察。

items.title_en: AGI-64 Brings Sierra Adventures to the Commodore 64
items.title_zh: AGI-64 把 Sierra 冒险带进 Commodore 64
items.summary_en: AGI-64 ports Sierra's AGI-era adventure games to the Commodore 64 by reimplementing the engine for the classic hardware. The project demonstrates how modern tooling can revive beloved titles on constrained machines and highlight retro-game preservation challenges.
items.summary_zh: AGI-64 通过为 Commodore 64 重新实现 AGI 引擎，将 Sierra 的 AGI 时代冒险游戏移植上去。该项目展示了现代工具如何让经典作品在受限硬件上重现，同时揭示了复古游戏保存的挑战。

items.title_en: Protobuf has LSP support
items.title_zh: Protobuf 已支持 LSP（语言服务器协议）
items.summary_en: Protobuf now has built-in LSP support, enabling editors to provide autocompletion, diagnostics, and refactoring for protobuf schemas. That reduces friction for developers who model APIs and data contracts, potentially speeding up schema evolution and integration across services. This aligns protobuf with other IDLs bridging IDE tooling.
items.summary_zh: Protobuf 现在原生支持 LSP（语言服务器协议），让编辑器能够对 protobuf 架构提供自动补全、诊断和重构等功能，减少 API 与数据契约建模时的摩擦，助力跨服务的模式演进与集成。这也使 protobuf 在 IDE 工具链方面与其他 IDL 看齐。

items.title_en: Rhombus 1.1 is now available
items.title_zh: Rhombus 1.1 发布
items.summary_en: Rhombus 1.1 is released, delivering updates and improvements to the language's syntax, tooling, and ecosystem. The release focuses on improved ergonomics for developers and better integration with the Racket ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: Rhombus 1.1 已发布，带来语言语法、工具链及生态系统方面的更新。该版本旨在提升开发者体验并加强与 Racket 生态的集成。

items.title_en: St Lucie Nuclear Reactor Unit 1 manually shutdown, 3 control rods drop into core
items.title_zh: St. Lucie 核电站1号机手动停机，三根控制棒落入堆芯
items.summary_en: St. Lucie Unit 1 was manually shut down after three control rods unexpectedly dropped into the core, triggering shutdown procedures. There were no radiation releases reported, and investigators will examine causes and preventive measures to avoid recurrence.
items.summary_zh: St. Lucie 核电站1号机因人工停机时有三根控制棒落入堆芯，触发停机程序。尚未发生放射性释放，相关部门将调查原因并评估防止类似事件的改进措施。

items.title_en: Show HN: Learn Flags Quiz
items.title_zh: Show HN：Learn Flags Quiz 学习国旗的练习应用
items.summary_en: Learn Flags Quiz is a simple, self-contained web game to help users memorize world flags, highlighting how lightweight, focused tools can aid learning.
items.summary_zh: Learn Flags Quiz 是一个简单的前端小型游戏，帮助用户快速记忆世界国旗，展示了轻量级工具在学习中的应用。

items.title_en: NIH is ending a key grant for budding clinical researchers
items.title_zh: NIH 结束面向新兴临床研究者的关键资助
items.summary_en: NIH is ending a key grant that supported aspiring clinical researchers. The move risks thinning the pipeline of early-career clinician-scientists and may force institutions to pivot training programs or seek alternative funding, potentially slowing translational research.
items.summary_zh: NIH 将停止一项支持初级临床研究者的关键资助，可能削弱早期临床研究人员的培养通道。机构可能被迫重新分配经费或调整培训计划，若缺乏新的替代支持，或会拖慢转化研究的进展。

items.title_en: MathCode, Mathematical Coding Agent
items.title_zh: MathCode：数学编码代理
items.summary_en: MathCode is a math-focused coding agent platform that integrates symbolic math with programmatic reasoning, enabling automated reasoning and code generation for mathematical tasks. It reflects a broader trend of building specialized AI that can reason over math with reliability.
items.summary_zh: MathCode 是一个聚焦于数学的编码代理平台，将符号数学与程序化推理结合，支持对数学任务的自动推理和代码生成。它体现了当今围绕“可靠地进行数学推理”的专业化 AI 架构趋势。

items.title_en: Red queen hypothesis – A new way forward for self-improving AI
items.title_zh: 红皇后假设：自我提升 AI 的新前路
items.summary_en: The piece reframes AI self-improvement through the Red Queen hypothesis, suggesting that continual improvement is driven by competitive dynamics rather than absolute progress. It explores implications for how self-improving systems might evolve and what safeguards may be needed.
items.summary_zh: 本文以红皇后假设为框架，讨论自我提升的 AI 如何在竞争环境中持续演化。分析潜在的演化路径及相关的安全与治理挑战。

items.title_en: How I developed an Am29000 C compiler and web browser
items.title_zh: 我如何为 AM29000 开发 C 编译器和网页浏览器
items.summary_en: A retro computing project detailing the creation of a C compiler and a web browser for the Am29000 architecture, illustrating the challenges of building a toolchain for niche hardware. It reveals how modern tooling can support vintage systems.
items.summary_zh: 这是一项复古计算机工程项目，讲述为 Am29000 架构开发 C 编译器和网页浏览器的过程，揭示为小众硬件构建工具链所面临的挑战，以及现代工具如何帮助复古系统重获生命。

items.title_en: Applying a photosynthetic process to treat “dry eye”
items.title_zh: 将光合作用原理用于治疗“干眼症”的尝试
items.summary_en: Researchers explore a bio-inspired approach to dry eye, leveraging photosynthetic processes to modulate the ocular surface. The concept aims to improve tear film stability or oxygenation through light-driven, biotechnological strategies.
items.summary_zh: 科学家提出以光合作用原理为灵感的干眼治疗方法，试图通过光驱动的生物技术手段改善眼表环境、提高泪膜稳定性或增氧。该方向代表把自然过程引入医疗的新尝试。

items.title_en: A True Telnet BBS on a Casio Calculator
items.title_zh: 在 Casio 计算器上实现的真实 Telnet BBS
items.summary_en: A Casio calculator runs a true Telnet BBS, a surprising feat of tiny-device networking and retro-computing prowess. The project highlights how small hardware can push real-world networking and hobbyist BBS culture.
items.summary_zh: 在一台 Casio 计算器上竟然运行着真实的 Telnet BBS，显示了极小设备网络能力的边界和复古计算的魅力。该项目凸显了在资源受限设备上实现实际网络服务的可能性。

items.title_en: GPS and the Lost Art of Getting Lost
items.title_zh: GPS 与失去的迷路艺术
items.summary_en: The article argues that GPS has eroded our natural sense of direction, diminishing navigational skills and cognitive mapping. It traces the evolution of cartography and weighs the trade-offs between convenience and the value of exploratory uncertainty.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为依赖 GPS 降低了人们在没有数字导航时的定向能力，并追溯了地图学和认知地图的历史。便捷性与探索精神的价值之间，需要权衡对导航技能与个人空间的影响。

items.title_en: Wellington second-hand bookstore's mysterious orders
items.title_zh: 惠灵顿二手书店的神秘订单
items.summary_en: Mysterious orders at a Wellington second-hand bookstore spark speculation about a coordinated project or hidden reading interests, highlighting how book markets intersect with curiosity and local culture.
items.summary_zh: 惠灵顿一家二手书店的神秘订单引发人们对是否存在协同行动或隐藏的阅读兴趣的猜测，显示书市与好奇心及本地文化之间的微妙联系。

items.title_en: Prolly: A content-addressed ordered map built on prolly trees
items.title_zh: Prolly：基于 prolly tree 的内容寻址有序映射
items.summary_en: Prolly introduces a content-addressed ordered map built on prolly trees, enabling efficient versioning and syncing for collaborative data. It targets scalable, immutable data structures for modern apps.
items.summary_zh: Prolly 提出一种基于 prolly tree 的内容寻址有序映射，支持高效的版本控制与跨设备同步，适用于现代应用的可扩展不可变数据结构。

items.title_en: Olo (Color)
items.title_zh: Olo（颜色）
items.summary_en: Olo is a color name; the article places it in color nomenclature and palettes.
items.summary_zh: Olo 是一种颜色名称，文中将其置于颜色命名与调色板的上下文。

items.title_en: How do I permanently disable random Google Photos popup to backup photos? (2024)
items.title_zh: 如何永久关闭 Google 照片随机弹出以备份照片？（2024）
items.summary_en: The thread discusses how to disable the backup prompt in Google Photos, outlining steps such as muting prompts, turning off backup & sync, or adjusting notification settings. It clarifies trade-offs between convenience and privacy.
items.summary_zh: 帖子给出关闭 Google 照片备份弹窗的做法，包含静音、关闭备份与同步、调整通知等步骤，并点出便利性与隐私之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Plastic mechanical computer from 1963: The Digi-Comp 1 [video]
items.title_zh: 1963 年塑料机械计算机：Digi-Comp 1 [视频]
items.summary_en: The Digi-Comp 1 is a 1963 plastic mechanical computer, demonstrated in a video that shows how marbles and tubes implement logic. It's a landmark in hands-on hardware education and a reminder of playful, tangible computing.
items.summary_zh: Digi-Comp 1 是一台1963年的塑料机械计算机，视频演示通过小球和管道实现逻辑运算。它是动手硬件教育的里程碑，也提醒人们边玩边学的早期可触及计算。

items.title_en: Falstad Math and Physics Simulations
items.title_zh: Falstad 的数学与物理仿真
items.summary_en: Falstad's browser-based math and physics simulations provide accessible, interactive visuals for concepts ranging from electricity to wave mechanics. It's a practical teaching tool and a quick sandbox for prototyping ideas.
items.summary_zh: Falstad 的浏览器端数学与物理仿真提供易用且直观的可视化工具，适合作为教学和快速原型验证。

items.title_en: Chestnut – eGPU dock with open-source firmware
items.title_zh: Chestnut：带开源固件的外接显卡盒
items.summary_en: Chestnut offers an eGPU docking solution with open-source firmware, appealing to tinkerers seeking customizable GPU setups without vendor lock-in. The open firmware enables community-driven updates, potentially broader hardware support and price competitiveness.
items.summary_zh: Chestnut 提供带开源固件的外接显卡盒，吸引愿意自定义硬件的玩家。开源固件使社区能更新和扩展兼容性，降低厂商锁定并提升性价比。

items.title_en: SIMD in the 90s: Programming Intel's Pentium MMX
items.title_zh: 90年代的 SIMD：在英特尔 Pentium MMX 上的编程
items.summary_en: A retrospective on 1990s SIMD shows how Intel's Pentium MMX introduced integer SIMD on x86, but with design constraints that limited portability and performance. The piece explains how MMX influenced later generations (SSE/AVX) and highlights early compiler and ISA trade-offs that still matter for modern vectorization.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 90 年代的 SIMD，介绍英特尔 Pentium MMX 如何在 x86 上引入整型向量指令，以及设计约束带来的可移植性与性能局限。文中阐述 MMX 如何影响了后续的 SSE/AVX，以及早期编译器与 ISA 的权衡，这些对如今的矢量化仍具启示作用。

items.title_en: Anton Chekhov played at love most of his life
items.title_zh: 契诃夫一生把爱情演得最为重要
items.summary_en: Chekhov's enduring preoccupation with love shaped his writing, with letters and anecdotes revealing how longing and restraint mingled with humor and human insight. The piece suggests intimate life experiences fed the tenderness and irony that define his work.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为契诃夫一生把爱情作为创作与生活的重要主题，书信与轶事揭示了情感渴望、克制与幽默如何融入他的笔触。爱情经历影响了他作品中的语气、洞察与对人性的描摹。

items.title_en: Low-Tech Ceramic Water Filter
items.title_zh: 低技术陶瓷水过滤器
items.summary_en: A simple, field-ready ceramic water filter design uses porous ceramic elements to remove bacteria and particulates, offering a low-cost solution for clean water in resource-poor settings. It’s durable, easy to manufacture, and widely used in humanitarian contexts, with maintenance focused on cleaning and replacing worn filters.
items.summary_zh: 一种简单、可在现场使用的陶瓷水过滤器通过多孔陶瓷元件去除细菌和颗粒，适用于资源匮乏地区的低成本净水方案。该设计耐用、易于制造，在人道主义场景中广泛应用，维护重点在于清洁与更换磨损的滤芯。

items.title_en: Does anyone run Postgres without PgBouncer?
items.title_zh: 有人在不使用 PgBouncer 的情况下运行 Postgres 吗？
items.summary_en: Some teams run Postgres directly without PgBouncer, arguing that modern connection pools and well-tuned workloads can avoid the extra hop.
items.summary_zh: 一些团队直接在 Postgres 上工作，不使用 PgBouncer，认为在经过优化的并发场景中可以避免额外的连接池开销。文中讨论连接开销、连接池生命周期，以及在高并发环境中 PgBouncer 是否仍具备价值。

items.title_en: A particle made of force: physicists say they've found mysterious 'glueball'
items.title_zh: 由力构成的粒子：物理学家称发现神秘的胶球
items.summary_en: Physicists report evidence for a glueball, a bound state of gluons with no quark content, a long-sought prediction of quantum chromodynamics. If confirmed, it would deepen understanding of how the strong force binds matter.
items.summary_zh: 物理学家报道发现无夸克组成的胶球的证据，这是一种由胶子组成的束缚态，长期被量子色动力学所预言。若得到确证，将深化对强相互作用如何结合物质的理解。

items.title_en: Clamiga: Common Lisp for the Amiga
items.title_zh: Clamiga：在 Amiga 上的 Common Lisp 实现
items.summary_en: Clamiga brings Common Lisp to the Amiga platform, offering a modern Lisp environment on this classic hardware. The project bridges retro computing enthusiasm with contemporary language tooling, showing that old machines can still run productive software.
items.summary_zh: Clamiga 让 Common Lisp 重返 Amiga 平台，提供在这台经典硬件上运行的现代 Lisp 环境。这个项目把复古计算热情与当代语言工具结合起来，显示了老机器仍然可以生产出有用的软件。

items.title_en: A quick look at zero-knowledge proofs
items.title_zh: 零知识证明速览
items.summary_en: A concise primer on zero-knowledge proofs explains the core idea: prove knowledge of a secret without revealing it. It sketches how ZKPs work at a high level and highlights common applications in authentication and privacy-preserving systems.
items.summary_zh: 简明的零知识证明入门介绍核心思想：在不暴露秘密的前提下验证对秘密的掌握。概述了工作原理的要点，并指出在认证与隐私保护系统中的典型应用。

items.title_en: The Mysterious Syndrome Destroying Endurance Athletes
items.title_zh: 毁掉耐力运动员的神秘综合征
items.summary_en: A mysterious syndrome is affecting endurance athletes, with researchers investigating metabolic, hormonal, or immune-related causes. The piece cautions against premature conclusions and emphasizes the need for more data.
items.summary_zh: 一种神秘综合征正在影响耐力运动员，研究者正在探索代谢、激素或免疫相关的原因。文章对过早结论保持谨慎，并强调需要更多数据。

items.title_en: A SAT Attack on Tarski's High School Algebra Problem
items.title_zh: 对塔尔斯基高中代数题的 SAT 攻击
items.summary_en: A SAT-based attack demonstrates how modern SAT solvers can tackle a classic algebra problem from Tarski, revealing insights about encoding strategies and solver limitations. The work shows the boundary between human-style reasoning and automated SAT reasoning for math problems.
items.summary_zh: SAT 求解器在解决塔尔斯基的高中代数题上展现出新的能力，揭示了编码策略和求解器的局限性。该研究凸显自动推理在数学题上的边界，以及人类直觉与机器推理之间的差异。

items.title_en: The oldest bar in every state
items.title_zh: 全美各州最古老的酒吧
items.summary_en: A lighthearted exploration of the oldest continuously operating bar in each U.S. state, pairing history with travel lore. It offers quirky trivia for readers planning road trips and a window into American drinking culture.
items.summary_zh: 盘点美国各州最古老且持续营业的酒吧，结合历史与民间传说。为计划公路旅行的读者提供趣味小知识，同时折射美国的酒业文化。

items.title_en: Superconducting monolayer cuprate with a single CuO2 plane
items.title_zh: 仅含一个 CuO2 平面的超导单层铜氧化物
items.summary_en: Researchers report a superconducting monolayer cuprate with a single CuO2 plane, pushing the boundaries of two-dimensional superconductivity. The finding deepens understanding of high-temperature superconductors and could influence how we design ultra-thin superconducting devices.
items.summary_zh: 研究报告仅含一个 CuO2 平面的超导单层铜氧化物，推动对二维超导现象的理解。此发现可能影响高温超导理论及超薄超导器件的设计。

items.title_en: Gakutensoku
items.title_zh: Gakutensoku（学天则）
items.summary_en: Gakutensoku is an early Japanese automaton; the article traces its history, design, and cultural significance in the development of robotics and art at the turn of the 20th century.
items.summary_zh: Gakutensoku 是日本早期的自动人偶，文章回顾其历史、设计与在二十世纪初机器人工艺与艺术发展中的文化意义。

items.title_en: How Go detects struct copies with sync.noCopy
items.title_zh: Go 如何用 sync.noCopy 检测结构体拷贝
items.summary_en: Explains how Go developers use a sync.noCopy embed to help tools like go vet detect unintended struct copies. The technique helps protect performance-sensitive codepaths—like locks and sync primitives—from costly copies.
items.summary_zh: 文章介绍了 Go 开发者如何通过嵌入 sync.noCopy 来帮助工具检测不小心的结构体拷贝。这一技巧有助于保护对性能敏感的代码路径（如锁和同步原语）免于昂贵的拷贝。

items.title_en: The Road to MS-DOS 2.0
items.title_zh: 迈向 MS-DOS 2.0 的历程
items.summary_en: Tracing the path to MS-DOS 2.0, the piece covers design shifts, memory management improvements, and compatibility challenges with CP/M-86. It illustrates how these decisions helped shape the early PC software ecosystem and industry competition.
items.summary_zh: 追溯到 MS-DOS 2.0 的路程，文章讲述设计变动、内存管理改进以及与 CP/M-86 的兼容性挑战。这些决策共同塑造了早期 PC 软件生态和行业竞争格局。

items.title_en: Shattered skeleton is first confirmed death from trebuchet
items.title_zh: 投石机致死的首次考古证据：被粉碎的骷髅
items.summary_en: Archaeologists confirm that a shattered skeleton represents the first direct evidence of a human death caused by a trebuchet during a siege. The finding sheds light on the lethality of medieval warfare and provides trauma patterns that enrich our understanding of historical conflict.
items.summary_zh: 考古学家确认这具被粉碎的骷髅是在围攻中因投石机造成死亡的首次直接证据。此发现揭示中世纪战争的致命性，并提供创伤模式，丰富了对历史冲突的理解。

items.title_en: A simple fix for LLM tail latency
items.title_zh: LLM 尾部延迟的简单修复
items.summary_en: A straightforward approach minimizes tail latency in large language model serving, improving responsiveness for latency-sensitive apps. The method is practical and easy to implement, helpful for teams tuning inference hot paths.
items.summary_zh: 提出一个简单可行的办法来降低大语言模型服务的尾部延迟，提高对延迟敏感应用的响应速度。该方法易于实现，适合在推理热路径上进行优化。

items.title_en: Intriguing stories in computer science
items.title_zh: 计算机科学中的引人入胜的故事
items.summary_en: A curated set of intriguing computer science stories that reveal lesser-known twists in algorithms, systems, and research, offering practical takeaways for practitioners.
items.summary_zh: 精选计算机科学中的有趣故事，揭示算法、系统与研究中的鲜为人知的曲折，为从业者提供实用启示。

items.title_en: Interview with Amit Patel, Creator of “Solar Realms Elite” (2013)
items.title_zh: Amit Patel：2013 年《Solar Realms Elite》的创造者访谈
items.summary_en: Patel reflects on the design choices and constraints that shaped Solar Realms Elite back in 2013, from its atypical pacing to platform decisions. The interview provides practical indie development insights—balancing ambition with accessibility and iterating under limited resources.
items.summary_zh: Patel 回顾了 2013 年《Solar Realms Elite》在节奏、平台选择等方面的设计取舍与限制。访谈提供了独立游戏开发中的实用经验：在资源有限的情况下追求野心与可及性的平衡并持续迭代。

items.title_en: Dancing with friends and enemies: boids' swarm intelligence (2012)
items.title_zh: Boids 群体智能：与朋友和敌人的舞蹈
items.summary_en: It discusses dynamics when agents have aligned or opposing goals, and what this means for modeling decentralized systems.
items.summary_zh: 文章通过 boids 模型展示了简单局部规则如何产生群体聚合行为，以及在目标一致或冲突时的动态。讨论了对去中心化系统建模的启示。
